one_command_repro: tar xzf g2-fover-repro.tar.gz && cd g2-fover-repro && bash run.sh
operator_action_required: Closing G2 requires a person who is NOT the operator to run the one-command package (or trigger the CI workflow) and report condition-A AUROC in [0.9027, 0.9235] and learning_contribution in [0.0125, 0.0245]. Per the Operator-Only External Publication discipline, autonomous work may build and verify the package but may not flip g2_independent_reproducer.

field_principles.honest_verdict: complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_ prefix required by CLAUDE.md Verdict Terminal-Prefix Discipline.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates: scores the verifier ensemble against the labeled FoVer corpus; no live LLM is loaded, so adversarial_verify.py applies the 1s floor not the 60s floor.
field_principles.package_path: dist/g2-fover-repro.tar.gz — the self-contained artifact a stranger runs with one command, no repo checkout.
field_principles.package_sha256: Content-addressed checksum — integrity + the G4 numbers-trace anchor (the package is what produced the verified numbers).
field_principles.package_cid: IPFS CID if a node was available, else null (decentralization rule 3: content-addressed mirroring).
field_principles.ipfs_available: Whether the CID could be computed this run.
field_principles.one_command_repro: The single command a stranger runs — the true-stranger test.
field_principles.clean_env_method: 'docker' | 'fresh_venv' — how the extracted package was verified, or null if no clean environment was available.
field_principles.condition_a_auroc_isolated: Recomputed production AUROC from the extracted self-contained package in a clean environment.
field_principles.learning_contribution_isolated: Recomputed FR-11 ablation; must land in [0.0125, 0.0245].
field_principles.package_verified_reproduces: Boolean: the extracted package reproduced BOTH numbers in their CIs from a clean environment (Docker/fresh venv).
field_principles.g2_independent_reproducer: MUST be false — only an actual external/CI run by a non-operator flips it true.
field_principles.operator_action_required: The one-line note that closing G2 needs a non-operator to run the package (Operator-Only External Publication).
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash anchoring the verified run (isolated harness checksum when available, else the package sha256).
field_principles.duration_s: Package build + clean-env install + CPU scoring wall time.
